test_title: PYST 40 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F lived in a building with 6 floors. Only one person lived on each floor. B lived just above D. 2 persons lived between D and F. D lived on one of the floors above F. A lived just above C who did not live on a floor second from the bottom. How many persons lived below E?
solution:
Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F lived in a building with 6 floors. Only one person lived on each floor.

1. B lived just above D.

2. 2 persons lived between D and F.

3. D lived on one of the floors above F.

4. A lived just above C who did not live on a floor second from the bottom.

No one lived below E.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 1**”.
